_notes: Generated by scripts/build_ag_zoning_codes.py from the running app's /api/facets; do not edit by hand (change the rules/overrides in the script and re-run it). counties: county -> {zoning_code exactly as stored in features.zoning_code: description}; the same code string can mean different things in different counties, so always match (county, zoning_code) pairs. review: county -> {code: why a borderline code was included or excluded}. Included: agricultural districts (agriculture, agricultural estate / agricultural-residential, ranch, grove, forestry/silviculture, agricultural reserve). Excluded: rural/estate residential, conservation/preservation, open space, PD/PUD. Skipped layers: pasco/zoning: zoning_code holds ZONEID (a polygon id); the district is ZN_TYPE, which is not loaded into zoning_code (sources.json field_map)
